note: The race for the neutral towns: seven switches on medium land maps, long games, 24 per config. In 549 long games won, undecided and lost games are alike until day 28; the enemy holds its third town on day 27-36 and its fourth on day 40-50, we on day 35-45 and 52-70 - from day 56 on undecided games stand at three towns against four. The enemy moves eight heroes from day 22 on, we three to four; on day 42 it has seen 44-60 % of the map, we 31-46 %. The two packages that brought the third town forward (expansion in the seven-switch test: towns on day 42 +0.48, explored +10 points; the way out in the eight-switch test) lost that lead by day 84 - which part does what? P = a guard in a gap counts with the region behind it (passage, regionValue 8000); U = land behind a guard counted from the guard (unlockDirect); F = troops fetched by their share of the army (fetchByShare); Z = the main hero looks 12 days ahead (mainHorizon 12); M = more heroes sooner, and three of them roam instead of one (three in week 1, five until day 21, six later, instead of two, three, four; collectorsRoam 3 - without it the extra heroes would sit in the garrisons); H = no hiring pause after a hero's loss while more than 15,000 gold lie idle (heroLossPause 0); S = three scouts. Design 2^(7-3), resolution IV: M = P*U*F, H = U*F*Z, S = P*F*Z. Evaluate with arena/effects.py and arena/metrics.py: --factors '{"P": {"passage": 1, "regionValue": 8000}, "U": {"unlockDirect": 1}, "F": {"fetchByShare": 1}, "Z": {"mainHorizon": 12}, "M": {"heroesWeek1": 3, "heroesWeek3": 5, "heroesLater": 6, "collectorsRoam": 3}, "H": {"heroLossPause": 0}, "S": {"scouts": 3}}'
